title: Basis Note of the Grain Accounting Desk: What Counts as Qualifying Business for Membership and Patronage Equity
content:
Qualifying business under Membership and Patronage Equity is what the member did with the cooperative in the fiscal year on a programme the relevant catalogue marks patronage-eligible, and it is recorded on the basis natural to that business.

**The basis natural to each stream.** Crop input purchases accrue on the invoiced amount net of discounts, so a discount taken reduces the units as well as the bill. Fuel accrues on gallons delivered and feed on tons delivered, both on the delivery date. Service work accrues on the amount billed.

**What accrues nothing.** Business done on a programme that is not patronage-eligible accrues nothing at all. Business done while the membership stands in applied is held and accrues to the membership once the board accepts it.

**Which fiscal year a parcel falls in.** The fiscal year a parcel of business falls in is fixed by the settlement, invoice or delivery date on the record, not by when the member paid for it, and the fiscal year ends 31 August.

**The floor for the year.** Where a member's qualifying business for a fiscal year falls under the class's minimum to qualify, no allocation is made for that year and the units are carried forward into the next.

**The rates each class earns at.** Each class carries its own rate on grain, on crop input spend, on refined fuels and propane, on feed and on services, and its own minimum qualifying business for the year, as the class schedule carries them.

## A clause of this note no longer in force

The following sentence of this note is **no longer in force** and is set down here only so that no reader applies it: "Grain marketed accrues on settled bushels rather than delivered bushels, so bushels delivered but still unpriced at the year end accrue in the year they are settled and not the year they were hauled." How far past the close of a fiscal year a late grain settlement is still gathered into the year that closed is now governed by the current basis, which is carried with the year-end grain accrual rules. Every other clause of this note stands as a clause in force.

## Points of judgement

| The parcel | The date the record carries | The year it accrues in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| a crop input invoice dated 12 August, paid the following October | the invoice date | the fiscal year ending 31 August of that year |
| a fuel delivery made 2 September | the delivery date | the fiscal year ending the following 31 August |
| a feed delivery made 14 July | the delivery date | the fiscal year ending 31 August of that year |
| field work billed 20 August on a programme not marked patronage-eligible | the billing date | none; it accrues nothing |

**On discounts.** A crop input invoice of 5000.00 on which a discount of 400.00 was allowed accrues 4600.00 of qualifying spend, the discount reducing the units as well as the bill.
